verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms documents split-chargeback instructions, so chargebacks can be allocated to the right user's balance account, with three handling options. Platforms can accept a chargeback for a user or collect the user's defense documents and upload them to Adyen. missing for 10: explicit documentation of evidence submission channels (API endpoint and dashboard flow), evidence that dispute outcomes (wins/reversals) automatically flow back into seller balances, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, disputes are managed per seller — chargebacks land against the right sub-merchant, evidence is submitted via API or dashboard, and outcomes flow back into seller balances automatically

citations.quote: you can provide instructions to split payments and chargebacks when you make calls to the following endpoints
You can choose between three different ways to handle potential chargeback events
You can either accept the chargeback on behalf of your user, or ask them to supply defense documents and upload them to Adyen.
